llm_top3.reasoning: MRK ranks only 6th quantitatively but has by far the most material positive catalyst — a surprise Phase 3 win for the personalized cancer vaccine with Moderna plus a Morgan Stanley upgrade — which outweighs the two sell-side downgrades. ADC pairs a top-2 quant rank with a genuine fundamental beat, record investment volume, a dividend raise and a $1M CEO open-market purchase. I take VTR over the top-ranked NTST because its Q2 beat, raised FY26 FFO guidance and $4.5B senior-housing investment pipeline are a stronger, demographically-supported growth story, whereas NTST's news flow is dominated by low-materiality 13F filings and it recently issued equity.
